newsitem.title: CAYMAN ISLANDS: Caymans Stock Exchange readies for first listing.
newsitem.headline: Caymans Stock Exchange readies for first listing.

text.p: The Cayman Islands Stock Exchange is likely to admit its first mutual funds listing soon, the exchange's Chief Executive Officer Ann Nealon said.
The listing could take place as early as next week, once the exchange is satisfied that all conditions for listing approval had been met, she said.
A number of other funds were expected to be approved in the near future, Nealon added.
She said 10 listing agents had been approved by the exchange, all from the Cayman Islands.

They were: Ansbacher (Cayman) Ltd, Bank of Butterfield International (Cayman) Ltd, Benbow Anderson & Co, CITCO Trust Company, Hunter & Hunter, Ian Boxall & Co, Maples and Calder, MeesPierson (Cayman) Ltd, Price Waterhouse and W.S. Walker & Co.
In addition, Butterfield Asset Management Ltd, Caledonian Securities Ltd and GH Securities Ltd were Broker Member firms.
"We welcome these firms as Broker Members and their commitment to the Cayman Stock Exchange," Nealon said.
"We expect to consider a second set of applicants shortly, and it is hoped that a strong broker member constituency will play an active role in the continued progress of the exchange."
